scope: Development diagnostics before the passing final checks. Intermediate test sources were not separately snapshotted; these logs do not support final validation claims.

logs.disposition: Two prior budget tests assumed the previous promotion counts. Their exact-result expectations are unchanged; they now admit the newly charged tensor-axis eliminations. The tensor-image refinement failure also now has a typed inner budget status.
Initial test compilation used a root re-export that does not exist. The final test uses hypersolve::curve_resultant::resultant_bivariate_polynomial_system_complete.
The product fixture needed only one resultant because exact quotient reduction removed the other axis. The final test preserves that shortcut and also checks a sum requiring two eliminations.
The initial assertion expected an outer ExactCurveError. This API instead retains a typed per-pair blocker inside its incomplete result; the enclosing BudgetOutcome is the resource error.
Confirms the typed BudgetExhausted pair blocker. The final integration test verifies this public contract, the outer failure, a successful exact retry, and three retained contacts.
